title: Retain Counter Dice (Library of Ruina)
description: Port of XDTM's Counter Dice Retain (Workshop 2787425839) as host callbacks on observation gates: a counter (Standby) die is not used up and keeps answering further attacks until it loses a clash, as in Early Access. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Retain Counter Dice
launcher.note: Counter Dices are kept and used against multiple attacks until it loses a clash, just like how it worked during Early Access. Original mod by [XDTM’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2787425839)

obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32. Offsets are the RVAs of dump.cs (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file). The three rows are the entries of the three methods the PC mod patches with Harmony prefixes; x0 = the BattlePlayingCardDataInUnitModel.
